title: Cottage
description: A tiny hillside cottage at golden hour.

title: Family Autumn
description: Our little family on a lazy autumn afternoon: the two of us on the sofa, the malamute by the fire, two British shorthairs, leaves falling outside the cabin.

title: Khao Sok
description: Morning mist over Cheow Lan lake: sheer limestone karsts, a waterfall with a rainbow, a giant dipterocarp with gibbons and a hornbill nest, elephants bathing, a floating raft village, a bat cave and a drowned temple — the rainforest of Khao Sok, Thailand, to explore stop by stop.
